summary: Adult referred by primary care for low mood and housing instability.

expected_facts.statement: Referred by her primary care clinic on 2026-09-28.
Low mood, poor sleep and missed work for about three months.
Wants to keep her job and find stable housing; asked for evening appointments.
Staying with a friend for six weeks after her lease ended in August; can stay until end of year at most.
No chronic conditions and no current prescriptions.
Reports drinking alcohol two or three times a week; denies other use; no prior substance use services.
Six outpatient counseling sessions Feb to Apr 2024, completed and discharged.
Grew up with mother and older sister; mother died in 2023; no children.
Sister lives nearby and helps with transportation.
Employed full time on day shifts at a warehouse; forklift certification in 2025.
Describes herself as organized; completed prior counseling; forklift certification.
